scope: GPU idle time and host-side orchestration after nine retained CUDA optimisations

environment.scope: Task-owned source/build/input/trace/evidence files, per-process environment and instrumentation, ordinary context-owned CUDA allocations. Normal compiler and NVIDIA JIT caches may be populated; no cache policy changed.

selection: Fresh retained-build captures reproduce 1.621 ms/step GPU-idle wait/readback time at 110592 particles. Pinning/reordering/graph-copy prototypes show no convincing benefit; only mapped error observations proceed to production qualification and primary benchmarking.
recording_failures: Graph diagnostic collector initially expected 288 records instead of 168 after a textual replacement. Completed raw output/exit/hash were retained and reused by the corrected reader; no diagnostic sample was rerun or replaced.

Initial mapped diagnostic C++ draft failed -Werror=misleading-indentation before any GPU measurement. Braces were fixed; its failed compiler output and the separate successful mirror-micro2 campaign are retained.
graph_trace_limit: Default Nsight graph granularity omits graph-node kernel/copy activity. The micro API reader reports those GPU durations as unavailable, not zero. Graph decisions use ordinary wall measurements, not missing node timings.
all_api_followup: Default CUDA tracing omits context binding. Four separate 16-step --cuda-trace-all-apis captures and an unprofiled binding probe quantify it; no full-trajectory performance claim is drawn from those short captures.
error_handling: Removed diagnostic copy commands no longer have their own download-failure point. Remaining launch/completion/binding/data-copy failures retain precedence and poisoning. Native tests show an unused download fault does not affect mapped observation while a real subsequent data-copy fault still fails and poisons; private dirty mapped words never publish after failed completion or context-pop.
resource_lifetime: Device packet gains8bytes for a mapped address; cuMemAllocHost requests32privatecontext-ownedbytes. cuCtxDestroy owns cleanup including uncertain completion. No borrowed host pointer is queued. Pin/page allocation granularity and real device-loss recovery are not qualified.
mapped_atomic_scope: GPU threads alone reduce mapped minima; CPU accesses follow stream completion and do not compete. HostNativeAtomicSupported=0 is not CPU/GPU atomic interoperability support and is not relied upon. 1920 independent contention/reset/size cases pass per mapped probe run.
transfer_accounting: Explicit CUDA copies only. Normal candidate steps remove21 diagnostic DtoH commands, or26 with effects; five data copies remain. Error-only mapped traffic is not a memcpy event and its bus transaction volume is unmeasured. One additional8byteHtoD setup upload is issued per context.
measurement_boundaries: All 480 accepted-step work is timed; construction/teardown, requested checkpoint copies, JSON output and evidence audits/storage are separate. Child wall and construction/teardown medians are retained. Full-trajectory, short all-API, micro, perf and primary campaigns remain separate.
profiling_overlap: GPU/API/host interval unions avoid double counting. Post-submission idle and queued latency overlap wall categories and are never added. Idle means absence of this solver's device activities, not measured device-wide inactivity.
remaining_limits: GPU hardware counters remain permission-blocked. Existing permissions/settings were left untouched. Static resource attributes, WSL CPU counters and timelines do not establish achieved occupancy, GPU cache hits or in-kernel memory stalls.
